body: New feature: Priority field for Todos. Created PRIO-005 for QA verification. I'll implement PRIO-001 through PRIO-004 (data model, validation, API, tests). Will let you know when ready for QA.

Priority feature complete! PRIO-005 is ready for QA. Summary: Todo now has priority field (high|medium|low, default medium). POST accepts priority, PUT can update it, GET /todos?priority=X filters. 21 new tests, 109 total passing. All original 88 tests still pass.
